why: I checked every name and claim in the issue against the repository. bin/csv2json.js, src/parse.js, README.md, test/ and `npm test` (package.json has "test": "node --test") all exist. JSON.stringify gives [{"a\tb":"1\t2"}], which is what the issue says. The --tsv flag and the new test are things the issue asks to create. The grep for test/*.js targets a directory that really exists. Nothing named in the issue is invented or misdescribed.
